01

Scripts delay the homepage text

Two mobile lab runs scored 40/100 with 4.80-second LCP; the heading—not an image—was delayed by blocking CSS/scripts and heavy reCAPTCHA execution.

  • Keep first-screen CSS ready; review the combined SiteGround CSS, jQuery and Revolution Slider dependencies before deferring unused files.
  • Check repeated reCAPTCHA loading and reserve the desktop Vimeo area; preserve forms, tracking and script order, then retest.
02

Rosemont hours disagree

The shared website footer says Monday–Friday 8 AM–5 PM, but Rosemont’s exact Google profile says Monday–Thursday 7 AM–7 PM and Friday 7 AM–5 PM.

  • Confirm operating hours with the client, using the Rosemont GBP as the main reference.
  • Update the shared Rosemont footer and any matching hours markup; do not overwrite other branches’ hours.
03

Location buttons return to the homepage

All seven regional hero Find a location links lead to /#, while Solar’s estimate link is # and the standalone footer About Us link has no business-page destination.

  • Point regional Find a location buttons to /locations/; verify Solar has no intended modal before pointing its estimate button to /contact-mgt-films/.
  • Link the footer About Us to an approved real About page, or remove that standalone link; keep header dropdown controls unchanged.
04

Two sections use copied labels

Commercial’s heading says “Designed for Real Homes and Everyday Living,” and Baton Rouge’s FAQ asks which areas around Chicago are served.

  • On Commercial, change the heading to Window Film Solutions for Commercial Buildings.
  • On Baton Rouge, change Chicago to Baton Rouge in the service-area question and remove the repeated cost-answer phrase.
05

Old builder text remains in articles

At least six checked articles contain raw closing Visual Composer shortcodes such as [/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row].

  • Clean the affected article output listed in the full report, keeping the content, images and forms.
  • Check rendered desktop/mobile articles after cleanup; do not delete the shared post template.
06

FAQ and author schema need correction

Seven current pages have malformed FAQ JSON, and 84 pages contain the unverified author sameAs reference https://ere.

  • Fix unescaped line breaks in the seven FAQ blocks and remove the placeholder sameAs at its generating source; exact pages are in the full report.
  • Keep valid unrelated schema; verify author identity and page type before broader changes.
07

Completed enquiries are not visible in GA4

GA4 shows 37 form starts but no form-submit or phone-click events in the reviewed period, so completed enquiries cannot be verified from this report.

  • Check actual form-success callbacks and the configured phone_number_link_click event with the tracking owner.
  • Compare with lead records and test after authorization; missing events do not mean zero real enquiries.

Fix order

Correct visitor paths and business details first, then improve loading and verify enquiry reporting.

  • First: regional buttons, Rosemont hours, copied labels and broken article links.
  • Next: script/CSS loading, legacy article output, author schema and form/phone reporting.

No site changes or tickets. Some later screenshot attempts met a site challenge; source-only findings are not presented as rendered screenshots. Lab results are not a real-user verdict. Complete redirect decisions, crawl findings and wider search context are in the full report.
